meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: TOR signalling and rapamycin influence lifespan partly through the SKN-1/Nrf and DAF-16/FoxO transcriptional programmes.
data.mechanism_beginner: Part of how this pathway affects lifespan runs through stress-resistance genes switched on by FOXO – so far shown mainly in simple animals like worms, not yet in mammals.
data.boundary: C. elegans only. DAF-16 is the FOXO orthologue; mapping worm lifespan genetics onto mammalian FOXO1/3 is an inference, not a demonstration.
